hole_interpretation: Manufacturer Dayton 8×Ø6.5 is in METAL BASKET. Choose FRONT MDF clearance hole from actual bolt shaft/head/washer or counterbore and fit, then choose a separate REAR INSERT pilot hole from insert maker, and check concentricity and weakest webs. Dimensions are not copied between these three different layers. For RAMPA M5x12 SKD30 the MDF catalogue pilot Ø9 differs from the HARDWOOD reference pilot Ø8; neither should be blindly transferred to glued beech 20mm pads without checking species, substrate and edge distances.
